title: Fix regression introduced by Apply-to-Oldest optimization
summary: The Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit was fixed to resolve a regression introduced by the Apply-to-Oldest optimization that affected application logic in general ledger posting.
key_points: Fixes a regression in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line caused by the Apply-to-Oldest optimization (issue #9529)
Fix applied in the W1, NA, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NO and RU layers
Four new tests guard against the regression, taken from partner PR #9881
One extra test confirms the optimization still exits early once the summed amount is enough
quote: Fix regression introduced by Apply-to-Oldest optimization.
